# beta.6 fixture templates

The workspace and repo wiring files were generated once with the v0.1.0-beta.6 source at `401e4dd1ed58e646538dbdac4304df2543b482ea` in a synthetic temporary HOME and repository. Paths are placeholders, timestamps are fixed, and repo ownership hashes are recalculated after substitution. The task template is copied from that tag. Tests use only these checked-in files; they do not query Git history or access any personal workspace. The legacy kit path is an inert placeholder; the fixture exercises current upgrade behavior and does not execute the old hooks.
